evals.prompt: I want to automate sending a Slack message whenever a new row is added to our Airtable CRM.
evals.expected_output: Level 3 — Workflow. Deterministic trigger (new Airtable row) and deterministic action (post to Slack). No judgment needed. Estimated build time: 1-2 hours.

evals.prompt: Should we build an agent or a workflow to triage incoming support tickets and route them to the right team member?
evals.expected_output: Level 4 — Agent. Routing by keyword is a workflow; routing by urgency, customer tier, and issue context requires judgment. Agent reads the ticket, assesses, routes with explanation.

evals.prompt: I want Claude to automatically review our weekly sales pipeline every Monday and highlight deals at risk.
evals.expected_output: Level 5 — Hybrid. Trigger (Monday cron) is deterministic → workflow. But 'highlight deals at risk' requires interpreting stage, last activity, forecast, and deal history — judgment heavy → agent. n8n fires Monday, agent reads pipeline data and produces risk assessment.
